title: A year of your DTR at a glance
description: The DTR page opens with a heat map of the last year: one square per day, darker the more hours you worked, so gaps and long stretches show up without reading the table.
items: Hover a day for its hours, or use the arrow keys to move between days
Days on approved leave are amber, with their own swatch in the legend, so you can tell leave from a day you missed. Leave still ends a streak
Underneath: total hours for the year, your busiest day, and your longest and current streaks
A team leader who picks a person in the filter sees that person's year
